facts.fact: The ODPC under Data Commissioner Immaculate Kassait is investigating and ruling under Kenya's Data Protection Act, 2019.
The ODPC examined whether the Business Registration Service violated the Data Protection Act, 2019 and issued an enforcement notice under it.
The ODPC has relied on Regulation 14(3)(e) when issuing compensation awards under the Data Protection Act; a High Court ruling questioned but did not invalidate it.
The ODPC ordered St Luke Orthopaedic & Trauma Hospital in Eldoret to pay a patient KSh525,000 for mishandling medical information.
The ODPC issued the Business Registration Service an enforcement notice after its own-motion investigation of a breach affecting over two million businesses.
